title: Book One · Chapter 71: Next Week on the Card
story:
Mr Sun gives Dad a small card on Friday.

Dad brings it home in his shirt pocket. There are days and times written on it.

Ronan reads the first word, then the next. He gets stuck at the bottom line.

“It says next week,” Dad tells him.

“All of next week?”

“Five days. We will speak again after that.”

Mum takes the card. She checks the morning times.

“I can take Ronan to school on those two days. On the others, you can leave together.”

Dad nods. “I start before the counter opens. I need to put the bench in order.”

Ronan sees a number beside the times. He knows it is money. Ronan wants many things for their home. This money would not buy all of them.

“Are we rich now?”

Dad takes off his shoes. “No.”

“Are we a little rich?”

“We have work for next week.”

Mum puts the card beside her own list of sewing jobs. “That is good news on its own.”

Mum takes a pencil and writes two amounts on her list. One is for food. One is for the room. She leaves another small space blank.

“What is that for?” Ronan asks.

“For things we have not thought of yet.”

“What will you write in that space?”

“I do not know yet. If we can, we will keep some extra money.”

Dad reads the list. He needs bus money for one early morning. He writes that on it too.

There is fish for supper. It is not a whole large fish. Mum cooked a little fish with greens and rice. Dad gives Ronan a piece, then carefully checks his own bowl for bones.

Ronan wants to celebrate Dad's new work days. He fetches his bicycle bell from the shelf.

“Dinner bell?” Mum asks.

“Work bell.”

He rings it once. The sound is sharp in the small room.

From the front room, Mrs Lan calls, “What happened?”

Dad laughs. Mum asks him to tell her. Ronan carries the bell to the yard and explains through the open door.

“Next week,” Mrs Lan says. “Good. Now let us eat without another bell.”

He puts the bell back. The wooden boat still has one green end. He runs a finger along the plain wood at the other end.

“Can we paint this on Sunday?”

Dad looks at it. “Not this Sunday. I promised to check some work with Mr Sun. We can look for a good time.”

Ronan's hand stays on the boat.

“You said one day.”

“I did. And I have not forgotten. I cannot give you this Sunday.”

Ronan looks down at the boat. He wanted to paint with Dad this Sunday.

After supper, Dad sits with him on the bed. “What colour do you want?” he asks Ronan. Ronan did not choose a colour. He wanted to finish the boat. He did not think about its colour until now.

“Red?” Dad asks.

“Perhaps blue. But the other end is green.”

“They can be different.”

They hold the boat between them. Dad checks a rough edge. “We will smooth this first,” Dad says. “Then we can paint it.” No paint appears tonight. Ronan is still a little disappointed.

Then Dad makes the boat rock on his knee. It falls onto the blanket. Ronan catches it there.

“Very rough water,” Dad says.

“Very soft sea.”

They sail it across the bed. Mum asks them to stay on their own side. Her sewing is on the other half.

Before sleep, Ronan looks at the small card on the table. Next week has five days of work on it. The little boat is unfinished, but Dad remembers it. Ronan will think about its colour before they paint.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- on its own＝本身
- celebrate＝庆祝
- smooth＝磨平
- disappointed＝失望的

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：bench＝工作台；bones＝鱼刺；rough edge＝粗糙边缘。

## 读句提示

**If we can, we will keep some extra money.**

如果办得到／我们会留一些额外的钱。if后只有一个完整分句。

## 理解问题

1. Dad的工作目前稳定到什么程度？
2. Dad没有答应哪个时间，又怎样陪伴Ronan？
